descriptionByLocale.fr: Officier de police : dans la police des transports 50-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Officier de police:à la police des transports de Bâle, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 50-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Nous recherchons plusieurs policiers dans le cadre d'un projet de construction sur la base stratégiquement importante de Bâle. Vous renforcerez l'équipe existante et veillerez à ce que les gens se sentent en sécurité dans les transports publics grâce à la police de proximité. Au lieu de la routine administrative, l'accent est mis sur des opérations proches de l'action – au-delà des frontières cantonales et au sein d'une équipe solide et reconnaissante. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires irréguliers. Grâce à des temps de repos clairement réglementés et à quelques équipes de nuit seulement, travail et vie privée peuvent être facilement conciliés à la Police des Transports des CFF. Vous pouvez choisir votre charge de travail de manière flexible entre 40 et 100 %, il n'y a aucune obligation d'avoir un lieu de résidence. Le travail de nuit et de week-end est rémunéré en supplément, par ex. B. avec 16 CHF de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche ainsi que des majorations de temps de 10 à 30 % pour les équipes de nuit. D’autres avantages tels que l’AG 2e classe gratuite, les allocations familiales et les voyages à prix réduits en Suisse et à l’étranger – vous les trouverez également pour votre famille sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que policier de la police des transports des CFF, vous et plus de 200 collègues dans toute la Suisse veillez à la sécurité, à la tranquillité et à l'ordre dans les gares et les transports publics auprès de différentes entreprises de transport. - Votre attention se porte sur les services de patrouille en uniforme dans les moyens de transport, les gares et sur les zones des entreprises de transport. - Dans votre rôle, vous apportez une contribution significative à la sécurité des voyageurs et du personnel des transports publics. - Lors des interventions policières, vous serez responsable de l'équipe et en collaboration avec les organismes partenaires - même lors d'événements majeurs. - Vous travaillez de manière orientée situation et êtes toujours à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics. - Vous participerez activement à la constitution de l'équipe et à sa formation. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - En tant qu'esprit d'équipe, vous appréciez travailler ensemble sur un pied d'égalité et contribuer activement à l'équipe. - Vous apparaissez ouvert, respectueux et professionnel et rencontrez des clients avec une solide compréhension du service. - Vous possédez le brevet d'officier de la Police fédérale I ainsi que des connaissances tactiques et techniques policières approfondies. - Vous vous caractérisez par de très bonnes compétences en allemand à l'oral et à l'écrit ; La connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale est un avantage. - Vous utilisez les outils numériques de manière sûre et responsable et les utilisez de manière ciblée dans les opérations quotidiennes. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence H, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
SBB Telecom verantwortet als privater Mobile Provider eine eigene, bahnkritische Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für den operativen Bahnbetrieb. Dazu gehören heute GSM-R, IMS und weitere bahnspezifische Kommunikationsdienste – und künftig FRMCS auf Basis von 5G.
Im Team BAK-Core gestalten und entwickeln wir die zentrale Kommunikationsplattform der SBB weiter. IMS spielt dabei eine Schlüsselrolle: als Service- und Kommunikationsplattform für Sprachdienste, SIP-basierte Kommunikation, Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Netzen sowie als Grundlage für künftige Mission-Critical-Services im FRMCS-Umfeld.
Die Weiterentwicklung dieser Systeme ist ein strategisches Zukunftsthema mit hoher Bedeutung für die Digitalisierung und Sicherheit des Bahnbetriebs. Dich erwartet eine Rolle mit fachlichem Tiefgang, langfristiger Perspektive und viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem technologisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld. Dabei arbeitest du nicht an isolierten Einzelsystemen, sondern an einer umfassenden privaten Mobilfunk- und Kommunikationsinfrastruktur, die den sicheren Bahnbetrieb der Schweiz unterstützt.

- Du definierst und überprüfst die Integration von IMS in eine komplexe Systemlandschaft mit GSM-R, 4G/5G-Komponenten, Core-Netzen, MCX und betrieblichen Umsystemen und begleitest die entsprechenden Life-Cycle-Vorhaben fachlich.
- Lieferanten begleitest du von der Spezifikation über die Realisierung bis zur Einführung und arbeitest dabei eng mit internen Fachstellen, Betrieb, Engineering, Architektur, Einkauf sowie externen Partnern zusammen.
Das bringst du mit.

- Du arbeitest gerne im Team und führst Lieferanten fachlich sicher durch Ausschreibungen sowie durch Lasten und Pflichtenhefte. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Telekommunikations-, Mobilfunk- oder Kommunikationsumfeld gesammelt oder bist motiviert, dich in dieses Themengebiet einzuarbeiten. Idealerweise bringst du Kenntnisse in Bereichen wie Requirements Engineering, System Engineering, technischer Spezifikation, Systemdesign oder Integrationsmanagement mit.
- Interesse an Kommunikationsplattformen, Sprachdiensten, Schnittstellen und deren Zusammenspiel; Erfahrungen mit IMS-Architekturen, SIP, VoLTE oder Mission-Critical-Services sind von Vorteil.

Un ambiente di lavoro innovativo vi aspetta, in cui spostate la SBB Cargo insieme ai vostri compagni di squadra. Inoltre, riceverete una formazione varia e pagata nella stazione di marshalling. Inoltre, diverse ulteriori opportunità di formazione sono aperte a voi, come la formazione come un autista del motore di shunting: locanda. Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst und überwachst die Züge an deinem Arbeitsplatz mit rund acht Bildschirmen. Im Normalbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr, steuerst die Abläufe und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Bei Störungen übernimmst du das operative Management: Du analysierst die Situation, leitest Massnahmen ein und behebst die Störung, damit der Normalzustand schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird. Damit trägst du die Mitverantwortung für die Mobilität der Schweiz. Ohne dich steht das Netz still. Der Job ist systemrelevant und unmittelbar wirkungsvoll: Du koordinierst Mensch und Technik, triffst rasche Entscheidungen und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Bahnverkehrs.
Wir bieten dir eine bezahlte Zweitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin oder zum Zugverkehrsleiter, die acht Monate dauert. Nach erfolgreicher Abschlussprüfung bist du in der Betriebszentrale in Zürich Flughafen oder im Rangierbahnhof Limmattal tätig und hilfst dabei, dass 9000 Personen- und 2000 Güterzüge täglich sicher und pünktlich ihr Ziel erreichen.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Infoveranstaltung .
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Sonntagsarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.

Das kannst du bewegen.

- Im Regelbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr; bei Störungen handelst du ruhig und effizient, leitest sofort Massnahmen ein und stellst den Normalbetrieb wieder her.
- Bei Störungen leitest du Massnahmen ein, damit der Normalzustand wiederhergestellt wird.
- Du koordinierst und kommunizierst mit Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen, Lokpersonal sowie Bau- und Rangierpersonal.
- Du verantwortest die Kundeninformation an Bahnhöfen und sorgst für klare, zeitnahe Mitteilungen.
- Dank deinem Einsatz sind Personen- und Güterzüge rund um die Uhr sicher und pünktlich unterwegs.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest gerne im Team und bist bereit, im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Du denkst strukturiert und vernetzt. In Stresssituationen handelst du schnell und überlegt. Die technische Affinität wird in der Ausbildung gefördert.
- Für die intensive und anspruchsvolle Ausbildungszeit bringst du viel Eigenverantwortung und Lernbereitschaft mit und bist motiviert, dich auf unterschiedliche Lernumgebungen einzulassen – vom Präsenzunterricht vor Ort bis zum digitalen Selbststudium.
- Du hast eine mindestens dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- In Deutsch bist du auf Niveau C2 sicher unterwegs. Ausserdem verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn ohne Rot-Grün-Schwäche.

Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Zurich Airport or Limmattal marshalling yard, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the operations center at Zurich Airport or in the Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start date: - March 1, 2027 - July 1, 2027 - November 1, 2027 You can move this. - As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operation you observe the traffic; In the event of disruptions, you act calmly and efficiently, take immediate action and restore normal operations. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - In German you are confident at level C2. descriptionByLocale.it: Macchinista ingresso laterale: in treno cantiere con esperienza manuale 100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Macchinista con accesso laterale: in treno da costruzione con esperienza manuale a Erstfeld, da ora in poi o previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Ti aspetta un programma di formazione a tempo pieno di 9 mesi vario e retribuito. Completate la vostra formazione teorica a Olten o Zurigo e fate la vostra prima esperienza pratica in uno scalo di smistamento assegnato a livello regionale. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. Puoi trovare vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - sul nostro sito web alla voce Benefit e maggiori informazioni sul lavoro qui. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista di treni da cantiere, dai un grande contributo al rinnovamento dei percorsi (binari, ghiaia, ecc.). - Effettui ed effettui autonomamente vari e complessi movimenti di manovra di treni fino ad un massimo di 100 km/h, li allestisci, smonti e li prepari per il viaggio. - Per garantire la logistica regionale, redigete, richiedete e ordinate gli ordini di guida in tempo e siete responsabili della fornitura dei cantieri con i materiali necessari. - Hai un'elevata responsabilità per la sicurezza operativa dei treni da cantiere. Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente e puoi agire consapevolmente e correttamente con il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente. - Possiedi almeno due anni di formazione professionale riconosciuta comprensiva di un certificato di idoneità, preferibilmente nel settore edile e con esperienza nella costruzione di binari oppure hai completato il diploma di scuola superiore. - Prerequisito è la conoscenza della lingua tedesca scritta e parlata (livello C1). - Possiedi la patente di guida di categoria B. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso/verde) e non sei iscritto nel registro penale o nelle esecuzioni. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Conducteur de train : en manœuvres ou spécialiste des manœuvres : à Olten, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100 % Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Un environnement de travail passionnant et innovant vous attend dans lequel vous pouvez conduire de grands changements et ainsi contribuer à la numérisation des CFF. Chez UHR (maintenance du matériel roulant), vous occuperez un poste clé au sein de l'usine d'Olten, avec de nombreuses tâches et responsabilités afin d'accompagner nos clients avec votre plein engagement. Avec vos coéquipiers, vous développerez des solutions aux défis actuels et les mettrez en œuvre en équipe. La formation continue n’est pas non plus négligée pour le développement professionnel individuel. À l'usine d'Olten, vous travaillez actuellement en deux équipes du lundi au vendredi entre 4h45 et 17h45. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que spécialiste des manœuvres, vous déplacez des wagons de voyageurs et de marchandises sous la direction du coordonnateur des manœuvres. - Votre domaine d'activité comprend entre autres l'attelage et le détachement des différents wagons ainsi que la manoeuvre des interrupteurs manuels et du poste de signalisation. Vous travaillez conformément aux prescriptions relatives aux services de transport et aux normes prescrites par les CFF. - La mise en service et la conduite d'unités multiples et de trains articulés font également partie de votre domaine de responsabilité. - Vous conduisez des locomotives de manœuvre, des véhicules rail-route, effectuez des tests de freinage et vous assurez qu'ils sont prêts à rouler. Vous êtes également responsable du petit entretien des véhicules. - La satisfaction du client est l'un de nos principaux objectifs. Vous travaillez chaque jour pour nos clients. Vous vivez notre culture de sécurité et appliquez constamment le processus d’amélioration continue (CIP). C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour que vous puissiez mener à bien cette tâche responsable, vous devez être en bonne forme mentale et physique. - Vous vous caractérisez par votre réflexion et vos actions en réseau, votre résilience, votre indépendance et votre volonté de prendre des responsabilités. - Un fort esprit d'équipe ainsi qu'une orientation client et qualité supérieure à la moyenne sont d'autres attributs qui décrivent bien votre caractère. - Pour le poste exigeant, vous devez avoir suivi une formation de base EFZ, idéalement en tant que logisticien dans le transport ou une formation similaire dans un sens artisanal/technique. - Idéalement, vous disposez d'une formation et d'une expérience en manœuvres, combinées à un accompagnement à la conduite conformément à la carte d'identité BAV VTE A40 direct. Alternativement, vous êtes indirectement opérateur de manœuvre Ai40 et souhaitez participer à la formation VTE A40. - Vous disposez de bonnes compétences linguistiques écrites et orales en allemand (au moins niveau B2). ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. descriptionByLocale.en: Shift manager: in transport 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shift manager: in Transport Oensingen, September 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a shift leader, you are responsible for operational management during the shift assigned to you and represent the team leader during this time. - In the team you are responsible for the operational management of personnel, trains and vehicles. You make functional instructions and assign them as needed to the group that is your area of ​​responsibility. - You ensure that safety rules and processes, as well as punctuality and safety, are adhered to when preparing trains in your area. - If there are deviations, you will take action independently to keep the impact on customers and operations as low as possible. - You represent the interests of SBB Cargo in the event of an incident. Based on your observations, you provide important information on how to improve processes and the use of resources. This is what you bring with you. - You enjoy working in a team and respect different personalities, you work independently and quickly find a good solution, even in difficult situations. You are actively committed to the safety of your colleagues and are a role model in everyday life. - You have comprehensive social and professional skills. You value making decisions in unforeseen situations. - Completed vocational training or several years of professional experience in the field of shunting as well as a good command of the local language are required. - A secure use of Office 365 is a matter of course for you, as is the application of the working time regulations of the GAV and the AZG. - You have a lot of experience in maneuvering. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level G, regional allowance level No regional allowance. More about pay and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in shunting 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in shunting Winterthur, October 1st, 2026, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.4 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey and move them to the correct starting point in and around the station (up to a maximum of 40 km/h). - You put trains together, separate individual cars and make sure that everything is in the right place. - You get the train ready to go, check the most important functions and carry out brake checks. - During your work, you maintain an overview and ensure that all processes run safely and smoothly. - You can repair minor problems yourself or report them to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and already have practical experience - ideally from a craft or logistics environment. - You have very good spoken and written knowledge of German (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 Goldau, 1 marzo 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Goldau, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103244 Stefan Lüthi, Training Manager Central Region Telephone +41 512 81 87 64 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans le transport de voyageurs 03/2027 Goldau, le 1er mars 2027, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Nous versons un salaire supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end – par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également d'un supplément de temps compris entre 10 et 30 pour cent. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. De plus, après une formation pour devenir conducteur de train, vous pouvez définir individuellement votre charge de travail à partir de 60 pour cent après consultation, avec différents modèles à temps partiel qui s'offrent à vous. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que conducteur de train, vous assumez non seulement la tête du train, mais également la responsabilité de la sécurité et de la ponctualité sur le réseau ferroviaire très fréquenté. - Pendant votre voyage, vous êtes attentif et réagissez rapidement et correctement aux signaux, aux contrôles de vitesse et aux événements imprévisibles. - Vous agissez de manière indépendante et êtes à tout moment en contact avec les centres d'opérations et les centres de contrôle. - Outre la conduite et les manœuvres des trains, vos tâches consistent également à vérifier l'état technique avant et après la prise en charge du véhicule. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous avez effectué un apprentissage de trois ans ou un diplôme d'études secondaires. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - Vous abordez les défis avec calme, prenez des décisions réfléchies même dans des situations stressantes et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts. - Vous parlez couramment l'allemand (niveau C2) et avez des connaissances de français débutant (niveau A1). - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. - Vous avez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de motivation pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante et êtes prêt à vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en classe sur site à l'auto-apprentissage numérique. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 Zugo, 1 marzo 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Zug, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103243 Stefan Lüthi, Training Manager Central Region Telephone +41 512 81 87 64 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale: dans le transport de voyageurs 03/2027 Zoug, le 1er mars 2027, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Nous versons un salaire supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end – par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également d'un supplément de temps compris entre 10 et 30 pour cent. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. De plus, après une formation pour devenir conducteur de train, vous pouvez définir individuellement votre charge de travail à partir de 60 pour cent après consultation, avec différents modèles à temps partiel qui s'offrent à vous. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que conducteur de train, vous assumez non seulement la tête du train, mais également la responsabilité de la sécurité et de la ponctualité sur le réseau ferroviaire très fréquenté. - Pendant votre voyage, vous êtes attentif et réagissez rapidement et correctement aux signaux, aux contrôles de vitesse et aux événements imprévisibles. - Vous agissez de manière indépendante et êtes à tout moment en contact avec les centres d'opérations et les centres de contrôle. - Outre la conduite et les manœuvres des trains, vos tâches consistent également à vérifier l'état technique avant et après la prise en charge du véhicule. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous avez effectué un apprentissage de trois ans ou un diplôme d'études secondaires. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - Vous abordez les défis avec calme, prenez des décisions réfléchies même dans des situations stressantes et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts. - Vous parlez couramment l'allemand (niveau C2) et avez des connaissances de français débutant (niveau A1). - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. - Vous avez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de motivation pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante et êtes prêt à vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en classe sur site à l'auto-apprentissage numérique. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le salaire spécifique pour ce rôle sous entrée latérale. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Rapperswil SG, October 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You will complete your theoretical training in Olten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103144 Fabian Heuberger, team leader Telephone +41 79 713 70 75 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour ce travail exigeant, vous êtes consciencieux, fiable, avez l'esprit d'équipe et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts de 24 heures. - Vous êtes physiquement et mentalement résilient et pouvez agir consciemment et correctement grâce à votre façon de travailler indépendante. - Vous disposez d'au moins deux années de formation professionnelle reconnue comprenant un certificat de compétence, idéalement dans le secteur de la construction et avec une expérience en construction de voies ou avez complété votre diplôme d'études secondaires. - La maîtrise de l'allemand écrit et parlé (niveau C1) est un prérequis. - Vous possédez un permis de conduire de catégorie B. - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge/vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Cambio di carriera: nel mondo delle professioni meccaniche e artigianali nella Svizzera tedesca, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Vuoi un lavoro in cui ogni mossa che fai conta? Hai completato un apprendistato nel settore meccanico e artigianale e vorresti fare la differenza in un ambiente lavorativo stimolante e innovativo? Allora sei nel posto giusto!
• Cerchiamo supporto in queste località della Svizzera tedesca: Zurigo, Brugg, Rapperswil e Winterthur. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Puoi allenarti nel centro fitness durante la settimana, goderti il ​​sole in piscina, fare shopping senza fare la fila: rendi semplicemente più flessibile il tuo tempo libero. Paghiamo un compenso aggiuntivo per il lavoro di guardia, notturno e nei fine settimana. A seconda degli incarichi paghiamo un supplemento tra 300 e 700 CHF al mese. Riceverai anche bonus di tempo del 10-30%. Ciò significa che puoi compensare queste indennità di tempo con tempo libero. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - Siete alla ricerca di un compito entusiasmante, vario e vario con cui potete dare un prezioso contributo ai clienti delle FFS? Le macchine grandi e moderne ti entusiasmano tanto quanto i compiti responsabili e complessi. - Nel tuo nuovo ruolo, a seconda delle tue qualifiche e competenze, sarai responsabile della costruzione, manutenzione e riparazione di sistemi ferroviari come linee aeree, binari, scambi, barriere, segnali o sistemi di protezione dei treni. Questo è un annuncio di pool per tutte le posizioni nell'area sopra menzionata. In base alle tue competenze, esperienza e formazione determineremo l'opportunità di ingresso più adatta a te. Puoi scoprire di più sui nostri interessanti profili lavorativi qui. - In qualità di giocatore di squadra, contribuirai a garantire che le interruzioni vengano rapidamente individuate e risolte. Ti piace dare una mano e ti piace lavorare all'aperto in tutte le stagioni. Come squadra, padroneggerete lavori impegnativi, principalmente meccanici/manuali, sui nostri sistemi. In questo modo fornite un prezioso contributo affinché i nostri clienti raggiungano la loro destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. - Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare (a volte nei fine settimana) e/o il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per le tue attività ricreative flessibili. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Un alto senso di responsabilità e sicurezza è un dato di fatto per te. Il lavoro di squadra e la comunità sono importanti per te quanto lo sono per noi. Nel nostro settore, i giochi di squadra sono la chiave del successo condiviso. - Ti piace dare una mano e sei aperto ai nuovi strumenti digitali. Per te la formazione continua è un dato di fatto. Attendi con ansia la formazione interna e l'istruzione superiore con retribuzione piena. - Avere completato la formazione meccanica e artigianale di base EBA o EFZ (meccanico di produzione, polimeccanico, meccanico di macchine agricole, meccanico generale, fabbro nel settore edile o professioni simili, ad es. giardiniere paesaggista). - Per poter svolgere il servizio di guardia è necessario essere in possesso della patente di guida di categoria B. Abbiamo bisogno di udito e vista illimitati, nonché di buona salute. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito D, livello di indennità regionale 2. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. descriptionByLocale.en: Career changer: in the world of mechanical and craft professions 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Career changer: in the world of mechanical and craft professions in German-speaking Switzerland, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Do you want a job where every move you make counts? At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. Have you completed an apprenticeship in the mechanical and craft sector and would you like to make a difference in an exciting and innovative working environment? Then you've come to the right place! We are looking for support in these locations in German-speaking Switzerland: Zurich, Brugg, Rapperswil and Winterthur. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. You can train in the fitness center during the week, enjoy the sun in the swimming pool, go shopping without queuing - simply make your free time more flexible. We pay additional compensation for on-call, night and weekend work. Depending on the assignments, we pay an additional between 300 and 700 CHF per month. You also receive 10-30% time bonuses. This means that you can compensate for these time allowances with free time. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - Are you looking for an exciting, diverse and varied task with which you can make a valuable contribution to SBB's customers? You are just as excited about large, modern machines as you are about responsible and complex tasks. - In your new role, depending on your qualifications and know-how, you will be responsible for the construction, maintenance and repair of railway systems such as overhead lines, tracks, switches, barriers, signals or train protection systems. This is a pool advertisement for all positions in the above-mentioned area. Based on your skills, experience and training, we will determine the most suitable entry opportunity for you. You can find out more about our exciting job profiles here. - As a team player, you will help ensure that disruptions are quickly located and resolved. You like to lend a hand and enjoy working outdoors in all seasons. As a team, you will master demanding, mainly mechanical/manual work on our systems. In doing so, you make a valuable contribution to ensuring that our customers reach their destination safely and on time. - You see irregular working hours (sometimes on weekends) and/or shift work as an advantage for your flexible leisure activities. This is what you bring with you. - A high sense of responsibility and safety is a given for you. Teamwork and community are just as important to you as they are to us. In our industry, team players are the key to shared success. - You like to lend a hand and are open to new digital tools. Continuous training is a given for you. You look forward to internal training and further education with full pay. - You have completed basic mechanical and craft training EBA or EFZ (production mechanic, polymechanic, agricultural machinery mechanic, general mechanic, locksmith in the construction industry or similar professions, e.g. landscape gardener). - In order to be able to perform on-call duty, you must have a category B driving license. We require unrestricted hearing and vision as well as good health. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision 5 - 6 weeks after receipt of application Application Final decision 5 - 6 weeks after receipt of application Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. Changeur de carrière : dans le monde des métiers de la mécanique et de l'artisanat en Suisse alémanique, dès maintenant ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Voulez-vous un travail où chaque geste que vous faites compte ? Chez CFF, vous avez la possibilité d'utiliser vos compétences tout en acquérant de nouvelles compétences qui enrichiront et feront progresser votre carrière. Vous avez effectué un apprentissage dans le secteur de la mécanique et de l'artisanat et vous souhaitez faire la différence dans un environnement de travail passionnant et innovant ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit ! Nous recherchons du soutien dans ces localités de Suisse alémanique : Zurich, Brugg, Rapperswil et Winterthur. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Vous pouvez vous entraîner au centre de remise en forme pendant la semaine, profiter du soleil dans la piscine, faire du shopping sans faire la queue - tout simplement rendre votre temps libre plus flexible. Nous versons une indemnité complémentaire pour le travail de garde, de nuit et de week-end. Selon les missions, nous payons un supplément entre 300 et 700 CHF par mois. Vous recevez également des bonus de temps de 10 à 30 %. Cela signifie que vous pouvez compenser ces heures perdues par du temps libre. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous recherchez une tâche passionnante, diversifiée et variée avec laquelle vous pourrez apporter une contribution précieuse aux clients des CFF ? Vous êtes tout aussi enthousiasmé par les grandes machines modernes que par les tâches responsables et complexes. - Dans votre nouveau rôle, en fonction de vos qualifications et de votre savoir-faire, vous serez responsable de la construction, de l'entretien et de la réparation des systèmes ferroviaires tels que les caténaires, les voies, les aiguillages, les barrières, la signalisation ou les systèmes de protection des trains. Il s'agit d'une annonce de pool pour tous les postes dans le domaine mentionné ci-dessus. En fonction de vos compétences, de votre expérience et de votre formation, nous déterminerons l’opportunité d’entrée la plus adaptée pour vous. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur nos profils d’emploi passionnants ici. - En tant qu'esprit d'équipe, vous contribuerez à ce que les perturbations soient rapidement localisées et résolues. Vous aimez donner un coup de main et appréciez travailler dehors en toutes saisons. En équipe, vous maîtriserez des travaux exigeants, principalement mécaniques/manuels, sur nos systèmes. Ce faisant, vous apportez une contribution précieuse pour garantir que nos clients atteignent leur destination en toute sécurité et à temps. - Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers (parfois le week-end) et/ou le travail posté comme un avantage pour vos loisirs flexibles. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Un sens élevé des responsabilités et de la sécurité est une évidence pour vous. Le travail d’équipe et la communauté sont tout aussi importants pour vous que pour nous. Dans notre secteur, l’esprit d’équipe est la clé du succès partagé. - Vous aimez donner un coup de main et êtes ouvert aux nouveaux outils numériques. La formation continue est une évidence pour vous. Vous attendez avec impatience une formation interne et une formation continue avec un salaire complet. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base mécanique et artisanale EBA ou EFZ (mécanicien de production, polymécanicien, mécanicien de machines agricoles, mécanicien général, serrurier du bâtiment ou professions assimilées, par ex. paysagiste). - Pour pouvoir effectuer des astreintes, vous devez être titulaire d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B. Nous avons besoin d’une audition et d’une vision sans restriction ainsi que d’une bonne santé. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence D, niveau d'allocation régionale 2. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature. ## C'est comme ça que ça continue. × Vous recevrez un premier retour de notre part au plus tard 10 jours ouvrables après réception de votre candidature. Pour notre base de Zurich, nous recherchons des policiers engagés et motivés qui souhaitent se consacrer à un poste passionnant et varié. Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. Nous travaillons également régulièrement avec d'autres corps de police et organismes partenaires, ce qui élargira votre réseau. Faites partie d'une équipe appréciée, dynamique et motivée qui veille à la sécurité et à l'ordre au-delà des frontières du canton. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 01/2027 Brugg AG, 1 gennaio 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 01/2027 Brugg AG, January 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have basic knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Conducteur de train à entrée latérale : dans le transport de voyageurs 01/2027 Brugg AG, 1er janvier 2027, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Nous versons un salaire supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end – par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également d'un supplément de temps compris entre 10 et 30 pour cent. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. De plus, après une formation pour devenir conducteur de train, vous pouvez définir individuellement votre charge de travail à partir de 60 pour cent après consultation, avec différents modèles à temps partiel qui s'offrent à vous. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - Vous abordez les défis avec calme, prenez des décisions réfléchies même dans des situations stressantes et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts. - Vous parlez couramment l'allemand (niveau C2) et possédez des connaissances de base en français (niveau A1). - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. - Vous avez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de motivation pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante et êtes prêt à vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en classe sur site à l'auto-apprentissage numérique. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux.
