- Bei Zwischenfällen, welche den Bahnverkehr beeinträchtigen, bist du mitverantwortlich für den Schutz von Menschen, Tieren, Umwelt und Bahninfrastruktur.

descriptionByLocale.it: Specialista dell'entrata laterale: nel soccorso ferroviario al 100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Specialista in ingresso laterale: nel soccorso ferroviario Ostermundigen, 1 agosto 2026, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Con Intervento FFS siete pronti 24 ore su 24 in caso di emergenza. Oltre 80 moderni veicoli di emergenza sono in uso su rotaie e strade. Cosa rende unico questo lavoro? Sei uno specialista ferroviario, un macchinista e un pompiere tutto in uno. Garantirai la sicurezza dei nostri clienti durante un evento e contribuirai a garantire che il traffico ferroviario ritorni alla normalità il più rapidamente possibile. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti. Puoi spostarlo. - In caso di allarme o durante le esercitazioni, come macchinista sarai schierato con la tua squadra sul treno antincendio e di soccorso e garantirai la sicurezza dei nostri clienti. - In caso di incidenti che riguardano il traffico ferroviario, sei corresponsabile della protezione delle persone, degli animali, dell'ambiente e dell'infrastruttura ferroviaria. - Sul posto garantisci la sicurezza di tutti i viaggiatori, combatti gli incendi sui binari e in prossimità di essi, fornisci protezione da oli e sostanze chimiche e assistenza tecnica. L’uso dei droni aiuta a valutare rapidamente la situazione. - Ti alleni regolarmente sui vari processi e tecniche di lavoro per garantire una gestione degli eventi fluida in ogni momento. Lavorerai su turni di 24 ore dal lunedì al venerdì e sarai reperibile nel fine settimana. Per noi gli orari di lavoro irregolari sono la regola. Ma potrete usufruire delle piste da sci gratuite durante la settimana e organizzare il vostro tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Scopri di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Grazie al tuo elevato senso di responsabilità e sicurezza, comprendi le dipendenze e gli effetti sulla tua squadra e sul tuo lavoro. Ciò che conta per noi è l’unione e la comunità in una squadra su cui puoi fare affidamento in qualsiasi momento. Ciò significa che ti piace lavorare in modo indipendente e sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente. - Hai completato un tirocinio professionale con un certificato di capacità federale (EFZ). Possiedi già la patente di guida per locomotive della categoria B100 o sei disposto a completare la relativa formazione interna retribuita. - Possiedi una patente di guida della categoria B e idealmente anche della categoria C1 118. - Sei idoneo alla protezione respiratoria e hai esperienza come vigile del fuoco. - Parli fluentemente la lingua tedesca (orale e scritta) e sei pronto per completare un diploma di francese di livello A1. - Durante la procedura di richiesta ti chiederemo di fornire un estratto aggiornato del tuo casellario giudiziale e del registro delle esecuzioni (non più vecchio di 3 mesi). Il documento può essere ordinato quando siete invitati a conoscervi di persona. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry specialist: in railway rescue 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry specialist: in railway rescue Ostermundigen, August 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. With SBB Intervention, you are ready around the clock in case of an emergency. Over 80 modern emergency vehicles are in use on rails and roads. What makes this job unique? You are a railway specialist, train driver and firefighter all in one. You will ensure the safety of our customers during an event and help ensure that rail traffic returns to normal as quickly as possible. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can move that. - In the event of an alarm or during exercises, as a train driver you will be deployed with your team in the fire and rescue train and ensure the safety of our customers. - In the event of incidents that affect rail traffic, you are jointly responsible for the protection of people, animals, the environment and rail infrastructure. - On site you ensure the safety of all travelers, fight fires on and next to the tracks, provide oil and chemical protection and technical assistance. The use of drones helps to quickly assess the situation. - You regularly train the various work processes and techniques to ensure smooth event management at all times. You will work 24-hour shifts from Monday to Friday and will be on call at the weekend. Irregular working hours are the rule for us. But you can enjoy free ski slopes during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. Find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - Thanks to your high sense of responsibility and security, you understand the dependencies and effects on your team and your work. What counts for us is togetherness and community in a team that you can rely on at any time. This means that you enjoy working independently and are physically and mentally resilient. - You have completed a vocational apprenticeship with a federal certificate of proficiency (EFZ). You already have a driving license for locomotives in category B100 or are willing to complete the relevant internal paid training. - You have a category B and ideally also category C1 118 driving license. - You are suitable for respiratory protection and have experience as a firefighter. - You are fluent in the German language (orally and in writing) and you are ready to complete a French diploma at level A1. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102797 Philippe Weyeneth, Ostermundigen site manager Telephone +41 79 593 47 42 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Spécialiste de l'entrée latérale : dans le sauvetage ferroviaire Ostermundigen, le 1er août 2026, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Avec Intervention CFF, vous êtes prêt 24 heures sur 24 en cas d'urgence. Plus de 80 véhicules d’urgence modernes sont utilisés sur les rails et sur les routes. Qu’est-ce qui rend ce métier unique ? Vous êtes à la fois spécialiste ferroviaire, conducteur de train et pompier. Vous assurerez la sécurité de nos clients lors d’un événement et contribuerez à ce que le trafic ferroviaire revienne à la normale le plus rapidement possible. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En cas d'alarme ou lors d'exercices, en tant que conducteur de train vous serez déployé avec votre équipe dans le train d'incendie et de secours et assurerez la sécurité de nos clients. - En cas d'incidents affectant le trafic ferroviaire, vous êtes solidairement responsables de la protection des personnes, des animaux, de l'environnement et des infrastructures ferroviaires. - Sur place vous veillez à la sécurité de tous les voyageurs, luttez contre les incendies sur et à proximité des voies, assurez la protection pétrolière et chimique et l'assistance technique. L’utilisation de drones permet d’évaluer rapidement la situation. - Vous formez régulièrement les différents processus et techniques de travail pour assurer à tout moment une gestion fluide des événements. Vous travaillerez 24 heures sur 24 du lundi au vendredi et serez de garde la fin de semaine. Les horaires de travail irréguliers sont la règle chez nous. Mais vous pouvez profiter des pistes de ski gratuites en semaine et organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible. Apprenez-en davantage sur le profil de poste ici. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB Cargo bist du am Puls der Schweizer Wirtschaft. SBB Cargo transportiert täglich 185.000 Tonnen und entlastet damit die Straße um 15.000 LKW-Fahrten pro Tag und die Umwelt jährlich um 460.000 Tonnen CO2. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB Cargo bewegst. Zudem erhältst du eine abwechslungsreiche und bezahlte Ausbildung im Rangierbahnhof. Darüber hinaus stehen dir verschiedene Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten wie die Ausbildung zum/zur Rangierlokführer:inn offen.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmäßigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - zum Beispiel mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30%. Das bedeutet, dass du mehr Freizeit hast als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

- Du übernimmst die Wagen, führst Sicherheitskontrollen durch und bereitest den Zug durch komplexe Rangierbewegungen für die nächste Fahrt vor.
- Du erfasst die notwendigen Daten für die Zugführung mit persönlichen, modernen IT-Geräten (z.B. Tablet).

Hier erfährst du mehr zum Berufsbild.

- Idealerweise hast du eine Grundausbildung abgeschlossen oder bringst bereits Berufserfahrung im handwerklichen, logistischen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich mit.
- Da sämtliche Anweisungen und Dokumentationen elektronisch sind, wirst du dich schnell mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln zurechtfinden.

Specialista della manovra: nella stazione della squadra Ai40 Berna, su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Con FFS Cargo avete il polso dell'economia svizzera. FFS Cargo trasporta ogni giorno 185.000 tonnellate, riduce il carico sulle strade di 15.000 viaggi di camion al giorno e riduce l'impatto sull'ambiente di 460.000 tonnellate di CO2 ogni anno. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo in cui voi e i vostri collaboratori potrete far progredire FFS Cargo. Riceverai anche una formazione varia e retribuita nello scalo di smistamento. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Per il lavoro notturno e nel fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni riceverai anche un'indennità compresa tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Possibili date di inizio nel 2026: - 1 agosto 2026 - 1 ottobre 2026 Puoi fare la differenza. - In qualità di specialista delle manovre, contribuirai a garantire che i nostri clienti siano serviti in modo affidabile e puntuale preparando i treni merci per il loro viaggio. - Prendi in consegna i vagoni, esegui i controlli di sicurezza e prepari il treno per il viaggio successivo attraverso complessi movimenti di manovra. - Registrate i dati necessari per il percorso del treno utilizzando moderni dispositivi informatici personali (ad es. tablet). - Consegnando e riconsegnando le auto presso la sede del cliente in modo tempestivo, hai un contatto diretto con il cliente su base giornaliera. Ricevi il loro feedback e, se necessario, lo inoltri all'ufficio responsabile. Puoi scoprire di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei attento, concentrato e fisicamente resistente per completare con successo questo lavoro impegnativo in turni di 24 ore. Ti piace anche lavorare all'aperto con qualsiasi tempo. - Idealmente, hai completato la formazione di base o hai già esperienza professionale nel settore dell'artigianato, della logistica o in un settore comparabile. - Poiché tutte le istruzioni e la documentazione sono elettroniche, potrai orientarti rapidamente utilizzando gli strumenti digitali. - In tedesco (livello C1) finché non parli e scrivi fluentemente. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito E, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. descriptionByLocale.en: Shunting specialist: in team station Ai40 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shunting specialist: in team station Ai40 Bern, by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You will also receive varied and paid training in the marshalling yard. There are also various further training opportunities available to you, such as training to become a shunting engine driver. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will also receive a time allowance of between 10 and 30%. This means that you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start dates in 2026: - August 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - As a shunting specialist, you will help ensure that our customers are served reliably and on time by preparing freight trains for their journey. - You take over the cars, carry out safety checks and prepare the train for the next journey through complex shunting movements. - You record the necessary data for train routing using personal, modern IT devices (e.g. tablet). - By delivering and dropping off the cars at the customer's site in a timely manner, you have direct customer contact on a daily basis. You receive their feedback and, if necessary, forward it to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Ideally, you have completed basic training or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - In German (level C1) until you are fluent in speech and writing. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102668 Beat Aeschlimann, team leader Telephone +41 79 610 93 18 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

descriptionByLocale.en: Police officer: in transport police 50-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Police officer: in Transport Police Olten, from now on or by appointment, 50-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. We are looking for several police officers as part of a construction project at the strategically important base in Olten. You will strengthen the existing team and ensure that people feel safe on public transport through community policing. Instead of administrative routine, the focus is on operations close to the action – across cantonal borders and embedded in a strong, appreciative team. Attractive working conditions are important to us – even with irregular working hours. Thanks to clearly regulated rest times and only a few night shifts, work and private life can be easily reconciled at the SBB Transport Police. You can choose your workload flexibly between 40-100%, there is no requirement to have a place of residence. Night and weekend work is paid additionally, e.g. B. with CHF 16 per hour for Sunday work as well as time surcharges of 10-30% for night shifts. Further benefits such as free GA 2nd class, child allowances and discounted travel at home and abroad – you can also find them for your family under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you and over 200 colleagues throughout Switzerland ensure safety, peace and order in train stations and public transport from various transport companies. - Your focus is on uniformed patrol services in means of transport, train stations and on the areas of transport companies. - In your role, you make a significant contribution to the safety of travelers and staff in public transport. - During police interventions, you will be responsible for the team and in collaboration with partner organizations - even at major events. - You work in a situation-oriented manner and always have your finger on the pulse of what is happening in public transport. - You will be actively involved in building the team and actively shaping it. This is what you bring with you. - As a team player, you value working together as equals and actively contribute to the team. - You appear open, respectful and professional and meet customers with a strong understanding of service. - You have the federal Police officer certificate I as well as in-depth police tactical and technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written German skills; Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You use digital tools safely and responsibly and use them in a targeted manner in everyday operations. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. descriptionByLocale.fr: Officier de police : dans la police des transports 50-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Officier de police : à la police des transports d'Olten, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 50-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en attendre avec impatience. Nous recherchons plusieurs policiers dans le cadre d'un projet de construction sur la base stratégique d'Olten. Vous renforcerez l'équipe existante et veillerez à ce que les gens se sentent en sécurité dans les transports publics grâce à la police de proximité. Au lieu de la routine administrative, l'accent est mis sur des opérations proches de l'action – au-delà des frontières cantonales et au sein d'une équipe solide et reconnaissante. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires irréguliers. Grâce à des temps de repos clairement réglementés et à quelques équipes de nuit seulement, travail et vie privée peuvent être facilement conciliés à la Police des Transports des CFF. Vous pouvez choisir votre charge de travail de manière flexible entre 40 et 100 %, il n'y a aucune obligation d'avoir un lieu de résidence. Le travail de nuit et de week-end est rémunéré en supplément, par ex. B. avec 16 CHF de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche ainsi que des majorations de temps de 10 à 30 % pour les équipes de nuit. D’autres avantages tels que l’AG 2e classe gratuite, les allocations familiales et les voyages à prix réduits en Suisse et à l’étranger – vous les trouverez également pour votre famille sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que policier de la police des transports des CFF, vous et plus de 200 collègues dans toute la Suisse veillez à la sécurité, à la tranquillité et à l'ordre dans les gares et les transports publics auprès de différentes entreprises de transport. - Votre attention se porte sur les services de patrouille en uniforme dans les moyens de transport, les gares et sur les zones des entreprises de transport. - Dans votre rôle, vous apportez une contribution significative à la sécurité des voyageurs et du personnel des transports publics. - Lors des interventions policières, vous serez responsable de l'équipe et en collaboration avec les organismes partenaires - même lors d'événements majeurs. - Vous travaillez de manière orientée situation et êtes toujours à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics. - Vous participerez activement à la constitution de l'équipe et à sa formation. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - En tant qu'esprit d'équipe, vous appréciez travailler ensemble sur un pied d'égalité et contribuer activement à l'équipe. - Vous apparaissez ouvert, respectueux et professionnel et rencontrez des clients avec une solide compréhension du service. - Vous possédez le brevet d'officier de la Police fédérale I ainsi que des connaissances tactiques et techniques policières approfondies. - Vous vous caractérisez par de très bonnes compétences en allemand à l'oral et à l'écrit ; La connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale est un avantage. - Vous utilisez les outils numériques de manière sûre et responsable et les utilisez de manière ciblée dans les opérations quotidiennes. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Rund 14 000 Mitarbeitende des Personenverkehrs sorgen dafür, dass die über 1,4 Mio. Kundinnen und Kunden der SBB, welche wir täglich befördern, einen einfachen Zugang zum Öffentlichen Verkehr erhalten und sowohl sicher als auch pünktlich von A nach B reisen. Das Rangierpersonal als zentrale Berufsgruppe leistet dafür einen zentralen Beitrag. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB bewegst, sowie eine abwechslungsreiche und bezahlte Ausbildung. Zudem hast du verschiedene interne Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Für Nachteinsätze erhältst du zusätzlich Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30 %. - Dabei stellst du Züge zusammen, trennst einzelne Wagen und sorgst dafür, dass alles am richtigen Platz ist.
- Du machst den Zug startklar, überprüfst die wichtigsten Funktionen und führst Bremskontrollen durch.
- Während deiner Arbeit behältst du den Überblick und sorgst dafür, dass alle Abläufe sicher und reibungslos funktionieren.
- Kleinere Störungen behebst du selbstständig oder meldest sie an die zuständige Stelle weiter.

- Du bist aufmerksam, konzentriert und körperlich belastbar, um diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb erfolgreich zu bewältigen. Ausserdem arbeitest du gerne bei jedem Wetter draussen.
- Da sämtliche Anweisungen und Dokumentationen elektronisch sind, wirst du dich schnell mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln zurechtfinden.
- Du hast eine abgeschlossene Grundbildung (mind. EBA) und bringst bereits praktische Erfahrung mit – idealerweise aus einem handwerklichen oder logistischen Umfeld.
- In Deutsch bringst du in Wort und Schrift gute Kenntnisse (Niveau B2) mit.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche)

Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nelle manovre Biel/Bienne, previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Circa 14'000 collaboratori del trasporto passeggeri garantiscono che gli oltre 1,4 milioni di clienti delle FFS che trasportiamo ogni giorno abbiano un facile accesso ai trasporti pubblici e viaggino da A a B in modo sicuro e puntuale. In quanto gruppo professionale centrale, il personale di manovra fornisce un contributo fondamentale a questo scopo. Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, nel quale ti muoverai alle FFS insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, oltre a una formazione varia e retribuita. Hai anche diverse opportunità di formazione interna. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni verranno applicati supplementi orari compresi tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Possibili date di inizio nel 2026: - 1 agosto 2026 - 1 ottobre 2026 Puoi fare la differenza. - Prepari i treni passeggeri per il loro viaggio e li sposti al punto di partenza corretto dentro e intorno alla stazione (fino a un massimo di 40 km/h). - Metti insieme i treni, separa i singoli vagoni e assicurati che tutto sia al posto giusto. - Prepari il treno per la partenza, controlli le funzioni più importanti ed effettui i controlli dei freni. - Durante il tuo lavoro mantieni una visione d'insieme e ti assicuri che tutti i processi si svolgano in modo sicuro e senza intoppi. - Puoi riparare tu stesso i problemi minori o segnalarli all'ufficio competente. Puoi scoprire di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei attento, concentrato e fisicamente resistente per completare con successo questo lavoro impegnativo in turni di 24 ore. Ti piace anche lavorare all'aperto con qualsiasi tempo. - Poiché tutte le istruzioni e la documentazione sono elettroniche, potrai orientarti rapidamente utilizzando gli strumenti digitali. - Hai completato l'istruzione di base (almeno EBA) e hai già esperienza pratica, idealmente in un ambiente artigianale o logistico. - Hai una buona conoscenza parlata e scritta della lingua tedesca (livello B2). - Hai un perfetto senso del colore (nessuna debolezza nel rosso/verde) ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefit. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in shunting 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in shunting Biel/Bienne, by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.4 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start dates in 2026: - August 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey and move them to the correct starting point in and around the station (up to a maximum of 40 km/h). - You put trains together, separate individual cars and make sure that everything is in the right place. - You get the train ready to go, check the most important functions and carry out brake checks. - During your work, you maintain an overview and ensure that all processes run safely and smoothly. - You can repair minor problems yourself or report them to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and already have practical experience - ideally from a craft or logistics environment. - You have good spoken and written knowledge of German (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level No regional allowance. More about pay and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 100933 Gilles Demierre Telephone +41 51 224 22 63 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Lateral entry train driver: in shunting Brig, by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.4 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible training starts in 2026: - May 1st, 2026 - October 1st, 2026 You can make a difference. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey and move them to the correct starting point in and around the station (up to a maximum of 40 km/h). - You put trains together, separate individual cars and make sure that everything is in the right place. - You get the train ready to go, check the most important functions and carry out brake checks. - During your work, you maintain an overview and ensure that all processes run safely and smoothly. - You can repair minor problems yourself or report them to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and already have practical experience - ideally from a craft or logistics environment. - You have good spoken and written knowledge of German (level B2). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level No regional allowance. More about pay and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. As a specialist in the transport police operations control center, you are the first point of contact for our customers and the train staff. This is what you bring with you. - Thanks to your service-oriented, open and winning manner, you always treat our customers and train staff in a friendly and professional manner. - Teamwork is important to you – you enjoy working with others and are actively involved in the team. - You will use your good IT and administration skills in a targeted manner in everyday operations. - Ideally, you have the federal police officer I certificate and have in-depth police tactical and technical knowledge, ideally supplemented by experience in an operations center. - You communicate clearly and confidently in German; Good knowledge of French (Level B1) is mandatory and other languages ​​such as Italian or English are a plus. ## Your salary and your benefits. Par vos efforts, vous apportez une contribution significative à la sécurité dans les trains et les gares. descriptionByLocale.en: Specialist: in the operations control center of the transport police | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Specialist: in the operations control center of the Olten Transport Police, from now on or by appointment, 40-100%, Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a specialist in the transport police operations control center, you are the first point of contact for our customers and the train staff. With your efforts, you make a significant contribution to safety on trains and stations. Thousands of travelers and employees trust you every day - you are a central factor for peace, order and a safe travel experience. You can move that. - As the first point of contact in the operations control center, you receive emergency calls and reports from customers and train staff, assess the situation and take the necessary steps quickly and reliably. - You support our colleagues at the front by professionally accompanying and coordinating operations throughout Switzerland and maintaining an overview of the situation at all times. - Together with over 190 colleagues in the train stations and on public transport, you make your contribution to safety, peace and order. - In close cooperation with our partner organizations, you will take on responsibility in the security network and help ensure that our customers feel well protected and safe at all times. This is what you bring with you. - Thanks to your service-oriented, open and winning manner, you always treat our customers and train staff in a friendly and professional manner. - Teamwork is important to you – you enjoy working with others and are actively involved in the team. - You will use your good IT and administration skills in a targeted manner in everyday operations. - Ideally, you have the federal police officer I certificate and have in-depth police tactical and technical knowledge, ideally supplemented by experience in an operations center. - You communicate clearly and confidently in German; Good knowledge of French (Level B1) is mandatory and other languages ​​such as Italian or English are a plus. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. Technician:in Safety Systems Interior, Electrical Installer:in, Automatic Engineer:in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Technician:in Safety Systems Interior, Electrical Installer:in, Automatic Engineer:in German-speaking Switzerland, as of now or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to that. As a technician: Indoor safety systems, you will independently locate and correct disturbances at our complex systems such as signal boxes and level crossings. You are the one who brings our customers back on track in an instant! Weekly you take over the Picettdienst – and of course there is a fair compensation. In addition, you are responsible for the maintenance, construction and of signalling and control systems. With a well-established team, check not only plants, but the smooth running of Switzerland’s largest transport company. We are looking for support at these locations of German-speaking Switzerland: Lucerne, Brugg, Spreitenbach and Sargans. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even in the case of irregular working hours. You can enjoy the free swimming pools and fitness centers during the week and make your free time more flexible. Night and weekend work is paid for with us. You will also receive time allowances. This means you have more free time than others without night and weekend assignments. Our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - can be found on our website under " Benefits". Further insights into the profession as a security system technician: inside you can get at the professional worlds of SBB or directly here: Technician: inside security systems | SBB You can make a difference. - You independently carry out construction and maintenance activities on the signal box interiors and partly on the exteriors. - You actively support the economical guarantee of the reliability, availability and safety of railway infrastructure facilities. During the Picetting Service, you will repair disruptions to the complex facilities to ensure their availability. - Depending on the project, you work occasionally at night and rarely on weekends. You bring that with you. - You are a technically affine personality with an independent and flexible way of working. - Unrestricted hearing and vision is required in order to be able to detect important acoustic and visual signals during track operations. - You have completed basic electrotechnical training EFZ (automatic: in, electrical installer: in or comparable professions). Ideally, you live close to the respective branch, as the willingness to provide weekly piquetting service is a prerequisite for this job. - Readiness to complete the 2-year internal training for technicians: in indoor safety systems. SBB assumes full time and costs for this. - Valid driving licence of category B as well as very good knowledge of German in words and writing at at least B2 level are required. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. This job is in Requirement Level E, Regional Allowance Level 2. ## This is the starting point. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. Therefore, we refrain from a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Making big is easier with you. Addetto alle manovre laterali: a Spreitenbach, d'ora in poi o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Con FFS Cargo avete il polso dell'economia svizzera. FFS Cargo trasporta ogni giorno 185.000 tonnellate, riduce ogni anno di 15.000 viaggi di camion il carico sulle strade e ogni anno di 460.000 tonnellate di CO2 l'impatto sull'ambiente. Aiuterai a garantire che i nostri clienti siano serviti in modo affidabile e puntuale. Ti aspetta un ambiente di lavoro entusiasmante, in cui tu e i tuoi compagni di squadra farete avanzare la Svizzera. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, per questo motivo durante la tua formazione riceverai la retribuzione intera. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 6 franchi l'ora per il lavoro notturno. Per i turni notturni riceverai anche un'indennità compresa tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi svilupparti ulteriormente internamente, ad esempio completando la formazione per diventare specialista di manovra o macchinista di manovra. Puoi spostarlo. - Effettui movimenti di manovra spostando, montando e smontando treni e vagoni merci. - I vostri compiti quotidiani comprendono l'aggancio e lo sgancio di locomotive e vagoni merci nonché l'esecuzione di prove di frenata. - Prepari i treni merci per il viaggio e ti assicuri che i veicoli parcheggiati nell'area dei binari siano protetti. - Nel tuo lavoro quotidiano utilizzi vari strumenti come radio e tablet per completare le tue attività in modo efficiente. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry for shunting employees: in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry shunting employee: in Spreitenbach, from now on or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck journeys every day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. You will help ensure that our customers are served reliably and on time. An exciting working environment awaits you, in which you and your teammates will move Switzerland forward. Attractive working conditions are important to us, which is why you will receive full wages during your training. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 6 francs per hour for night work. For night shifts you will also receive a time allowance of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can develop further internally, for example by completing training to become a shunting specialist or shunting train driver. You can move that. - You carry out shunting movements by moving, assembling and dismantling freight trains and wagons. - Your daily tasks include coupling and uncoupling locomotives and freight cars as well as carrying out brake tests. - You prepare freight trains for travel and ensure that parked vehicles in the track area are secured. - In your everyday work, you use various tools such as radios and tablets to complete your tasks efficiently. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - Because of your safety awareness, it is natural for you to work according to regulations. - You are physically fit for this demanding 24-hour shift work and enjoy working outside in any weather. - Ideally, you have completed basic training or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. - You have good oral German skills (at least level B1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level C, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. Bei SBB Cargo bist du am Puls der Schweizer Wirtschaft. Du trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zuverlässig und pünktlich bedient werden. Auf dich wartet ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die Schweiz bewegst.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, deshalb bekommst du auch während deiner Ausbildung den vollen Lohn bezahlt. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 6 Franken pro Stunde für Nachtarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30%. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Du kannst dich intern weiterentwickeln, indem du beispielsweise die Ausbildung zum Rangierspezialist:in oder Rangierlokführer:in abschliesst.

- Zu deinen täglichen Aufgaben zählt das Kuppeln und Entkuppeln von Lokomotiven und Güterwagen sowie das Durchführen von Bremsproben.
- Du bereitest Güterzüge für die Fahrt vor und sorgst dafür, dass abgestellte Fahrzeuge im Gleisbereich gesichert sind.
- Im Arbeitsalltag nutzt du verschiedene Hilfsmittel wie Funkgeräte und Tablets, um deine Aufgaben effizient zu erledigen.

- Idealerweise hast du eine Grundbildung abgeschlossen oder bringst bereits Berufserfahrungen im handwerklichen, logistischen oder vergleichbaren Bereich mit.

A40 e minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale nel campo del TP - Completamento del certificato FSEA o formazione didattica equivalente, o disponibilità a seguire tale formazione. - Spirito di iniziativa e personalità comunicativa, avendo già esperienza come formatore o in altra attività legata alla formazione - Piacere nel lavorare con i giovani - Competenze metodologiche e didattiche, nonché un atteggiamento sicuro e professionale ## Cosa ti aspetta: Un'attività varia ed impegnativa, con un certo margine di manovra, in un ambiente dinamico. Abbiamo suscitato il tuo interesse? Per qualsiasi ulteriore informazione non esitate a contattare Simon Eng, responsabile della formazione. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura tramite il nostro strumento di candidatura.

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB hast du die Chance, dein Können einzubringen und dir gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten anzueignen, die dich beruflich bereichern und weiterbringen.
Als Bauzugbegleiter:in kannst du einen Grundstein legen für eine weitere Karriere als Lokführer:in Bauzüge.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits und mehr Infos zum Beruf findest du hier
Das kannst du bewegen.
- In dieser abwechslungsreichen Position trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Bauzüge pünktlich abfahrbereit sind und sicherst damit die Eisenbahnbaulogistik.
- Als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du die betriebliche und technische Zuguntersuchung und unterstützt den/die Lokführer:in bei sicheren Zugfahrten von A nach B.
- Du begleitest dabei sowohl Rangier- als auch Zugfahrten.
- Nebst deiner Tätigkeit als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du auf der Baustelle eine Sicherheitsfunktion oder unterstützt deine Kollegen:innen bei Arbeiten im Gleisbereich.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb bist du körperlich und psychisch belastbar und arbeitest gerne bei jedem Wetter draussen.
- Du hast eine Grundbildung abgeschlossen und verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre. Zudem bringst du bereits Berufserfahrungen im handwerklichen, logistischen oder vergleichbaren Bereich mit.
- Die Weiterbildungen zum Bauzugbegleiter:in (Kat. Ai), Sicherheitswärter:in und oder Sicherheitschef:in hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
- Bei deiner täglichen Arbeit bedienst du unter anderem ein Tablet. Der Umgang mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln bereitet dir keine Mühe.
- In Deutsch bist du fliessend in Wort und Schrift.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche).

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau D, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Specialista della manovra: nell'infrastruttura Winterthur, 1 marzo 2026 o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisirne di nuove che arricchiranno e faranno progredire la vostra carriera. In qualità di addetto ai treni edili puoi gettare le basi per un'ulteriore carriera come macchinista dei treni edili. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. Puoi trovare vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - sul nostro sito web alla voce Benefit e maggiori informazioni sul lavoro qui. Puoi fare la differenza. - In questa posizione diversificata contribuirai a garantire che i nostri treni da cantiere siano pronti a partire in orario e quindi a garantire la logistica della costruzione ferroviaria. - In qualità di addetto ai treni di cantiere, ti occupi delle ispezioni operative e tecniche dei treni e assisti il ​​macchinista nei viaggi in treno sicuri da A a B. - Accompagni sia le manovre che i viaggi in treno. - Oltre al tuo lavoro come addetto ai treni di costruzione, assumi un ruolo di sicurezza in cantiere o assisti i tuoi colleghi quando lavorano nell'area dei binari. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente per questo lavoro impegnativo su turni di 24 ore e ti piace lavorare all'aperto con qualsiasi tempo. - Hai completato la formazione di base e idealmente hai completato un apprendistato professionale. Hai anche esperienza professionale nel settore dell'artigianato, della logistica o in settori comparabili. - Hai completato con successo la formazione continua per diventare addetto ai treni edili (Cat. Ai), guardia di sicurezza e/o capo della sicurezza. - Nel tuo lavoro quotidiano usi, tra le altre cose, un tablet. Non devi preoccuparti di utilizzare moderne attrezzature da lavoro. - Parli correntemente il tedesco parlato e scritto. - Hai un perfetto senso del colore (nessuna debolezza nel rosso/verde). ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito D, livello di indennità regionale 1. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. descriptionByLocale.en: Shunting specialist: in infrastructure 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shunting specialist: in infrastructure Winterthur, March 1st, 2026 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. As a construction train attendant, you can lay the foundation for a further career as a construction train driver. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can make a difference. - In this varied position, you will help ensure that our construction trains are ready to leave on time and thus ensure railway construction logistics. - As a construction train attendant, you take on operational and technical train inspections and support the locomotive driver in safe train journeys from A to B. - You accompany both shunting and train journeys. - In addition to your work as a construction train attendant, you take on a safety role on the construction site or support your colleagues when working in the track area. This is what you bring with you. - You are physically and mentally resilient for this demanding work in 24-hour shifts and enjoy working outside in any weather. - You have completed basic training and ideally have completed a vocational apprenticeship. You also have professional experience in crafts, logistics or comparable areas. - You have successfully completed the further training to become a construction train attendant (Cat. Ai), security guard and or head of security. - In your daily work you use, among other things, a tablet. You don't have to worry about using modern work equipment. - You are fluent in spoken and written German. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 101977 Dirk Polzin, team leader Telephone +41 79 172 36 89 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes résilient physiquement et mentalement pour ce travail exigeant en quarts de 24 heures et aimez travailler dehors par tous les temps. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base et idéalement effectué un apprentissage professionnel. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Es erwartet dich eine 14-monatige bezahlte Teilzeitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin bzw. zum Zugverkehrsleiter. Nach erfolgreicher Abschlussprüfung trägst du aus der Betriebszentrale am Zürich Flughafen tatkräftig dazu bei, dass 9000 Reise- und 2000 Güterzüge täglich pünktlich und sicher ihr Ziel erreichen. Bereits während der Ausbildung liegt uns deine Work-Life-Balance am Herzen. Deshalb kannst du deine Praxistage für die Ausbildungszeit im 60% Pensum frei wählen und die restlichen Tage somit gut vorzeitig für deine Life-Balance einplanen.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - zum Beispiel mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%. Das bedeutet, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Zugverkehrsleiterin oder Zugverkehrsleiter spielst du eine wichtige Rolle für den reibungslosen Ablauf des Bahnverkehrs und hast grossen Einfluss auf die Zufriedenheit der Kundinnen und Kunden.
- Du behältst den Überblick über das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz und lenkst die darauf verkehrenden Züge ökologisch.
- Dazu kommunizierst du mit Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen, Lokführerinnen und Lokführern sowie Leitstellen und verantwortest die Information für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden an Bahnhöfen.
- Wenn eine Störung auftritt, reagierst du sicherheitsorientiert und schnell, um den Normalbetrieb wiederherzustellen.
- In deiner täglichen Arbeit greifst du auf verschiedenste Systeme zurück. Entsprechend basiert deine Arbeit auf dem Vertrauen in das Zusammenspiel zwischen Mensch und Technik.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Berufsinformationsveranstaltung .
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit bist du gewissenhaft, zuverlässig, teamfähig und bereit, im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Dein vernetztes Denken und deine eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise helfen dir, bei Störungen schnell und richtig zu reagieren.
- Du hast eine 3-jährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen.
- In der Sprache des Ausbildungsstandortes bist du verhandlungssicher sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich (Niveau C2) und bringst idealerweise Kenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache (Niveau A1) mit.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche).
- Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir von dir einen aktuellen Straf- und Betreibungsregisterauszug (nicht älter als 3 Monate) verlangen. Die Dokumente kannst du bei der Einladung zum persönlichen Kennenlernen bestellen.

Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale (formazione a tempo parziale) Aeroporto di Zurigo, 1 settembre 2026, 60% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Puoi aspettarti 14 mesi di formazione part-time retribuita per diventare responsabile del traffico ferroviario. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, contribuirai attivamente dalla centrale operativa dell'aeroporto di Zurigo a garantire che ogni giorno 9.000 treni passeggeri e 2.000 treni merci arrivino a destinazione in tempo e in sicurezza. Il tuo equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata è importante per noi durante la tua formazione. Ecco perché puoi scegliere liberamente i tuoi giorni pratici per il periodo di formazione con un carico di lavoro del 60% e pianificare con largo anticipo i giorni rimanenti per il tuo equilibrio di vita. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Per il lavoro notturno e nel fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Se lavori di notte riceverai anche un'indennità dal 10 al 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di responsabile del traffico ferroviario, svolgi un ruolo importante nel buon funzionamento del traffico ferroviario e hai una grande influenza sulla soddisfazione dei clienti. - Tieni traccia della rete di collegamenti che ti è stata assegnata e gestisci i treni che la percorrono in modo ecologico. - Comunicherai con i compagni di squadra, i macchinisti e i centri di controllo e sarai responsabile di fornire informazioni ai nostri clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie. - Se si verifica un'interruzione, reagire in modo sicuro e rapido per ripristinare il normale funzionamento. - Nel tuo lavoro quotidiano utilizzi un'ampia varietà di sistemi. Di conseguenza, il tuo lavoro si basa sulla fiducia nell’interazione tra persone e tecnologia. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo sulla carriera. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Per questo lavoro impegnativo, sei coscienzioso, affidabile, un giocatore di squadra e disposto a lavorare su turni di 24 ore. - Il tuo pensiero in rete e il tuo modo di lavorare indipendente ti aiutano a reagire rapidamente e correttamente alle interruzioni. - Aver completato un tirocinio professionale di 3 anni o un diploma di scuola superiore. - Parli fluentemente la lingua del luogo di formazione, sia verbalmente che per iscritto (livello C2) e possibilmente conosci una seconda lingua nazionale (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso del colore (nessuna debolezza nel rosso/verde). - Durante la procedura di richiesta vi chiederemo di fornire un estratto aggiornato del vostro registro penale e delle esecuzioni (non più vecchio di 3 mesi). Puoi ordinare i documenti quando ci inviti a incontrarti di persona. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Lateral entry train traffic manager (part-time training) Zurich Airport, September 1st, 2026, 60% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You can expect 14 months of paid part-time training to become a train traffic manager. After successfully completing your final exam, you will actively contribute from the operations center at Zurich Airport to ensuring that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination on time and safely every day. Your work-life balance is important to us during your training. That's why you can freely choose your practical days for the training period with a 60% workload and plan the remaining days well in advance for your life balance. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. If you work at night, you will also receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - As a train traffic manager, you play an important role in the smooth running of rail traffic and have a major influence on customer satisfaction. - You keep track of the route network assigned to you and manage the trains running on it ecologically. - You will communicate with teammates, train drivers and control centers and be responsible for providing information to our customers at train stations. - If a disruption occurs, you react safety-oriented and quickly to restore normal operation. - In your daily work you use a wide variety of systems. Accordingly, your work is based on trust in the interaction between people and technology. Find out more about the career profile at the next career information event. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work 24-hour shifts. - Your networked thinking and your independent way of working help you to react quickly and correctly to disruptions. - You have completed a 3-year vocational apprenticeship or high school diploma. - You are fluent in the language of the training location, both verbally and in writing (level C2) and ideally have knowledge of a second national language (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). You can order the documents when you invite us to meet you in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Responsable du trafic ferroviaire à entrée latérale (formation à temps partiel) Aéroport de Zurich, 1er septembre 2026, 60% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Vous pouvez vous attendre à 14 mois de formation rémunérée à temps partiel pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous contribuerez activement, depuis le centre opérationnel de l'aéroport de Zurich, à ce que 9 000 trains de passagers et 2 000 trains de marchandises atteignent chaque jour leur destination à temps et en toute sécurité. Votre équilibre travail-vie personnelle est important pour nous pendant votre formation. C'est pourquoi vous pouvez choisir librement vos journées pratiques pour le stage avec une charge de travail de 60% et planifier les jours restants bien à l'avance pour votre équilibre de vie. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Si vous travaillez de nuit, vous bénéficierez également d'une indemnité horaire de 10 à 30 %. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, vous jouez un rôle important dans le bon déroulement du trafic ferroviaire et avez une influence majeure sur la satisfaction des clients. - Vous suivez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué et gérez écologiquement les trains qui y circulent. - Vous communiquerez avec vos coéquipiers, les conducteurs de train et les centres de contrôle et serez responsable de fournir des informations à nos clients dans les gares. - En cas de perturbation, vous réagissez de manière sûre et rapide pour rétablir un fonctionnement normal. - Dans votre travail quotidien, vous utilisez une grande variété de systèmes. Par conséquent, votre travail est basé sur la confiance dans l’interaction entre les personnes et la technologie. Apprenez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information sur les carrières. Vous pouvez commander les documents lorsque vous nous invitez à vous rencontrer en personne. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale (formazione a tempo parziale) Olten, 1 settembre 2026, 60% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Puoi aspettarti 14 mesi di formazione part-time retribuita per diventare responsabile del traffico ferroviario. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, contribuirai attivamente dalla centrale operativa di Olten a garantire che 9.000 treni passeggeri e 2.000 treni merci arrivino ogni giorno a destinazione in tempo e in sicurezza. Il tuo equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata è importante per noi durante la tua formazione. Ecco perché puoi scegliere liberamente i tuoi giorni pratici per il periodo di formazione con un carico di lavoro del 60% e pianificare con largo anticipo i giorni rimanenti per il tuo equilibrio di vita. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Per il lavoro notturno e nel fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Se lavori di notte riceverai anche un'indennità dal 10 al 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di responsabile del traffico ferroviario, svolgi un ruolo importante nel buon funzionamento del traffico ferroviario e hai una grande influenza sulla soddisfazione dei clienti. - Tieni traccia della rete di collegamenti che ti è stata assegnata e gestisci i treni che la percorrono in modo ecologico. - Comunicherai con i compagni di squadra, i macchinisti e i centri di controllo e sarai responsabile di fornire informazioni ai nostri clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie. - Se si verifica un'interruzione, reagire in modo sicuro e rapido per ripristinare il normale funzionamento. - Nel tuo lavoro quotidiano utilizzi un'ampia varietà di sistemi. Di conseguenza, il tuo lavoro si basa sulla fiducia nell’interazione tra persone e tecnologia. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo sulla carriera. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train traffic manager (part-time training) 60% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager (part-time training) Olten, September 1st, 2026, 60% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. You can expect 14 months of paid part-time training to become a train traffic manager. After successfully completing the final exam, you will actively contribute from the operations center in Olten to ensuring that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination on time and safely every day. Your work-life balance is important to us during your training. That's why you can freely choose your practical days for the training period with a 60% workload and plan the remaining days well in advance for your life balance. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. If you work at night, you will also receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Vous pouvez vous attendre à 14 mois de formation rémunérée à temps partiel pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire. Après avoir réussi l'examen final, vous contribuerez activement, depuis le centre opérationnel d'Olten, à ce que 9 000 trains de voyageurs et 2 000 trains de marchandises atteignent chaque jour leur destination à temps et en toute sécurité.
